runs.label: Point-in-time members
runs.caveat: Uses the index membership actually in force on each rebalance date — point-in-time constituent file, 2718 dated snapshots from 1996-01-02.
runs.missing_note: 437 companies that were index members at some point have no price history available from the free data source — mostly firms acquired, taken private or wound up. They are skipped, so a residual survivorship bias remains here too: much smaller than ranking today's members would produce, but not zero. Membership itself comes from a community-maintained dataset, not an official S&P feed.
